statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); dir=$(basename "$cwd"); git_info=""; if git -C "$cwd" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then branch=$(git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo "detached"); dirty=""; if ! git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks diff --quiet 2>/dev/null || ! git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks diff --cached --quiet 2>/dev/null; then dirty="*"; fi; git_info=" [${branch}${dirty}]"; fi; lsp=""; [ -n "$(find "$cwd" -maxdepth 2 \( -name "*.ts" -o -name "*.tsx" -o -name "*.js" -o -name "*.jsx" \) 2>/dev/null | head -1)" ] && lsp="${lsp} ts"; [ -n "$(find "$cwd" -maxdepth 2 -name "*.go" 2>/dev/null | head -1)" ] && lsp="${lsp} go"; [ -n "$(find "$cwd" -maxdepth 2 -name "*.lua" 2>/dev/null | head -1)" ] && lsp="${lsp} lua"; lsp_info=""; [ -n "$lsp" ] && lsp_info=" (${lsp# })"; printf "%s%s%s" "$dir" "$git_info" "$lsp_info"
